name: field-officer-tracker
description: Field officer location check-in with photo, mobile and a WhatsApp-style location picker, plus a manager dashboard with radius search. Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2.

scripts.db:console: wrangler d1 execute field-officers --remote --command "SELECT name, mobile, city, address FROM checkins ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.secrets: wrangler secret put MANAGER_PASS && wrangler secret put ADMIN_PASS
